title: 日本ダービーの後に・二冠達成

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Another victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: And another step closer to seizing my dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Satsuki Sho already in hand, this makes two crowns. Symboli Rudolf raises her hand high, two fingers pointing skyward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Two crowns claimed. One to go.

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Rudolf! Rudolf! Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this victory, a new Derby Champion is born—and with Rudolf now poised to claim the Triple Crown, the crowd's excitement can't be contained.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their elation is infectious, quickly spreading to every last person…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Including a certain Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Two crowns! Congratulations, President. I must say, you raced splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha…

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's so funny?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, nothing. I've just never seen you with your cheeks so red before.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm glad I took part in the Derby for that alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Please don't tease me. Is it wrong to get a little sentimental when a friend accomplishes something so great?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not at all. I only hope you'll greet me with twice the enthusiasm after my next race.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You mean…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But of course. My next goal is to challenge the Kikuka Sho and claim the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Next stop, the Kikuka Sho. Symboli Rudolf's goal is so close I can practically taste it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Surely you realize that this will strain your schedule to the limit?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Summer may be coming, but you will have more press interviews than ever. And naturally, the student council will be—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, I'm listening. Please, continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: With respect, you do look rather tired.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha. Forgive me. Even I can't maintain perfect form after a race like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Perhaps you should refrain from student council work for a little—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I believe we have already discussed that point. Let's move on to something more constructive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: To pick up on your earlier point, the student council has important work to do come the summer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come now, Trainer. Surely you haven't forgotten.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Every year, the academy holds a summer camp to help the students improve their racing skills. The student council helps to organize it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah yes, that reminds me. Air Groove, can you contact the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We need to change the number of buses we'll be hiring, and there are also some other issues I want to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That being said, the press is outside, and I can hardly keep them waiting. Let's see now…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'll be back at the academy in two hours. Could you set up the meeting for when I return?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even with the Japanese Derby under her belt, Symboli Rudolf shows no signs of relaxing her unforgiving schedule.
